content:
<thought>We need to retrieve polymorphs for the remaining oxide compositions (31 more) using the same filters (max_energy_above_hull = 0.3, max_per_composition = 3) and save them to the existing “oxides_data” directory. After this batch retrieval we will consolidate all JSON files (the first five plus these new ones) into a single dataset and return its file path.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "ZnO",
        "MgO",
        "CaO",
        "SrO",
        "BaO",
        "CoO",
        "NiO",
        "MnO",
        "Cr2O3",
        "V2O5",
        "MoO3",
        "WO3",
        "PbO",
        "PbO2",
        "SnO2",
        "Bi2O3",
        "Ti3O5",
        "ZrO2",
        "HfO2",
        "Nb2O5",
        "Ta2O5",
        "La2O3",
        "CeO2",
        "Nd2O3",
        "Sm2O3",
        "Gd2O3",
        "Y2O3",
        "Sc2O3",
        "Ti2O3",
        "GeO2",
        "In2O3"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "oxides_data"
}
